This '''tomb''' was the final resting place of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush's]] mummified remains after his [[Death/Legends|assassination]] in the year [[6950 BBY]]. Graush's fifty-year reign of terror and cruelty produced a dizzying amount of corpses, which he then experimented on using [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] and [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]] to produce a [[Korriban zombie|zombie army]]. At some point in his life, Graush had replaced his heart with a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Heart of Graush|crystal]], which, after his death, was used to capture the spirits of his [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]].
The crystal was laid to rest with Graush's remains and the zombies lay dormant until a [[Sentience/Legends|being]] touched the Heart.
